columns.label: Peredur
columns.what: A bleeding spear and a severed head — no vessel at all
columns.heals: Asking what you have just seen
columns.cost: A household left in its wound

columns.label: The Vulgate
columns.what: The vessel of the Last Supper, which caught Christ's blood
columns.fail: By sin — above all by love
columns.cost: The best knight in the world, disqualified
columns.end: Carried to Britain by Joseph's line

columns.label: The Queste
columns.what: A test in the shape of a relic
columns.heals: Nothing: it judges rather than heals
columns.fail: By being an ordinary good knight
columns.end: The worthy removed from the world

columns.label: Wolfram
columns.what: A stone, which feeds those before it
columns.heals: One question, asked out of pity
columns.fail: By not noticing that somebody is suffering
columns.cost: Years of the questioner's own life and faith
columns.end: The wound closed; the king relieved; a hero crowned and living

columns.label: Malory
columns.what: The Holy Grail, covered with white samite, borne by no one visible
columns.who: Galahad, and at a distance Percival and Bors
columns.heals: The blood of the spear, applied by Galahad
columns.cost: The fellowship, and the king says so out loud
columns.end: Taken up to heaven; never seen again
